data.name: period_configurations
constraints:
CHECK ((mode = 'calendar_month' AND custom_start_day IS NULL) OR
            (mode = 'custom_cycle' AND custom_start_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31))
CHECK (mode IN ('calendar_month', 'custom_cycle'))

UNIQUE (owner_id, start_date)
FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, configuration_id) REFERENCES period_configurations (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: income_recurrence_templates
constraints:
CHECK ((frequency = 'monthly' AND monthly_reference_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31) OR
            (frequency = 'by_period' AND monthly_reference_day IS NULL))
CHECK (frequency IN ('monthly', 'by_period'))

CHECK ((value_mode = 'fixed' AND default_amount_centavos IS NOT NULL) OR
            (value_mode = 'variable' AND default_amount_centavos IS NULL))
CHECK (value_mode IN ('fixed', 'variable'))

CHECK (
      default_amount_centavos IS NULL OR (
        length(default_amount_centavos) BETWEEN 1 AND 19
        AND default_amount_centavos NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
        AND (default_amount_centavos = '0' OR
            substr(default_amount_centavos, 1, 1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9')
        AND (length(default_amount_centavos) < 19 OR
            default_amount_centavos <= '9223372036854775807')
      )
    )
FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id) REFERENCES categories (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id, subcategory_id) REFERENCES subcategories (owner_id, category_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (subcategory_id IS NULL OR category_id IS NOT NULL)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_preferences" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "theme" TEXT NULL, "time_zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'America/Sao_Paulo', "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "period_configurations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "custom_start_day" INTEGER NULL, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), CHECK ((mode = 'calendar_month' AND custom_start_day IS NULL) OR
            (mode = 'custom_cycle' AND custom_start_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31)), CHECK (mode IN ('calendar_month', 'custom_cycle')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounting_periods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "configuration_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), CHECK (start_date < end_date), UNIQUE (owner_id, start_date), FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, configuration_id) REFERENCES period_configurations (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), CHECK (kind IN ('income', 'expense')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subcategories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id) REFERENCES categories (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, UNIQUE (owner_id, category_id, id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "income_recurrence_templates" ("description" TEXT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "starts_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "monthly_reference_day" INTEGER NULL, "value_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_amount_centavos" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "subcategory_id" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), CHECK ((frequency = 'monthly' AND monthly_reference_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31) OR
            (frequency = 'by_period' AND monthly_reference_day IS NULL)), CHECK (frequency IN ('monthly', 'by_period')), CHECK ((value_mode = 'fixed' AND default_amount_centavos IS NOT NULL) OR
            (value_mode = 'variable' AND default_amount_centavos IS NULL)), CHECK (value_mode IN ('fixed', 'variable')), CHECK (
      default_amount_centavos IS NULL OR (
        length(default_amount_centavos) BETWEEN 1 AND 19
        AND default_amount_centavos NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
        AND (default_amount_centavos = '0' OR
            substr(default_amount_centavos, 1, 1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9')
        AND (length(default_amount_centavos) < 19 OR
            default_amount_centavos <= '9223372036854775807')
      )
    ), FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id) REFERENCES categories (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id, subcategory_id) REFERENCES subcategories (owner_id, category_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK (subcategory_id IS NULL OR category_id IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_recurrence_templates" ("description" TEXT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "starts_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "monthly_reference_day" INTEGER NULL, "value_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_amount_centavos" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "subcategory_id" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), CHECK ((frequency = 'monthly' AND monthly_reference_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31) OR
            (frequency = 'by_period' AND monthly_reference_day IS NULL)), CHECK (frequency IN ('monthly', 'by_period')), CHECK ((value_mode = 'fixed' AND default_amount_centavos IS NOT NULL) OR
            (value_mode = 'variable' AND default_amount_centavos IS NULL)), CHECK (value_mode IN ('fixed', 'variable')), CHECK (
      default_amount_centavos IS NULL OR (
        length(default_amount_centavos) BETWEEN 1 AND 19
        AND default_amount_centavos NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
        AND (default_amount_centavos = '0' OR
            substr(default_amount_centavos, 1, 1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9')
        AND (length(default_amount_centavos) < 19 OR
            default_amount_centavos <= '9223372036854775807')
      )
    ), FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id) REFERENCES categories (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id, subcategory_id) REFERENCES subcategories (owner_id, category_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK (subcategory_id IS NULL OR category_id IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "income_entries" ("description" TEXT NULL, "amount_centavos" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "subcategory_id" TEXT NULL, "recurrence_template_id" TEXT NULL, "scheduled_for_date" TEXT NULL, "scheduled_period_id" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_on" TEXT NULL, "accounting_period_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, accounting_period_id) REFERENCES accounting_periods (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, recurrence_template_id) REFERENCES income_recurrence_templates (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id) REFERENCES categories (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id, subcategory_id) REFERENCES subcategories (owner_id, category_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK (
      amount_centavos IS NULL OR (
        length(amount_centavos) BETWEEN 1 AND 19
        AND amount_centavos NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
        AND (amount_centavos = '0' OR
            substr(amount_centavos, 1, 1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9')
        AND (length(amount_centavos) < 19 OR
            amount_centavos <= '9223372036854775807')
      )
    ), CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'received', 'cancelled')), CHECK (status <> 'received' OR
            (received_on IS NOT NULL AND accounting_period_id IS NOT NULL
            AND amount_centavos IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (amount_centavos IS NOT NULL OR recurrence_template_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (status <> 'pending' OR
        (received_on IS NULL AND accounting_period_id IS NULL)), CHECK (subcategory_id IS NULL OR category_id IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "old_snapshot_json" TEXT NULL, "new_snapshot_json" TEXT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "applied_sync_operations" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "result_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "applied_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "idempotency_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remote_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolution_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_retry_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "idempotency_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_order_value" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "source_table"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX unique_income_occurrence_schedule ON income_entries (owner_id, recurrence_template_id, scheduled_for_date) WHERE recurrence_template_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX income_entries_period_idx ON income_entries (owner_id, accounting_period_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX unique_expense_occurrence_schedule ON expense_entries (owner_id, recurrence_template_id, scheduled_for_date) WHERE recurrence_template_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX expense_entries_period_idx ON expense_entries (owner_id, accounting_period_id)
